thread:
Mira Chen: heads up — after last night's KMS rewrap I see embeddings API keys successfully calling /v1/chat completions. this looks like a scope enforcement gap :rotating_light:
Samir Patel: wait, embeddings tokens hitting chat routes? do you have request ids or logs?
Mira Chen: yup, two request ids from 23:12 UTC: rq_8f7a9 and rq_8f7b0. logs show 200s on /v1/chat for tokens that only list 'embeddings' in the auth store. pasted minimal log: ```
2024-11-08T23:12:11Z auth-svc INFO validate token_id=tkn_3 scope=[embeddings] route=/v1/chat/completions result=ALLOW request_id=rq_8f7a9
```
Aleks Novak: if the auth-svc deserializes KMS-wrapped metadata, a missing tag could fall back to legacy route-allowlist. we had a recent change to how rewraps serialize the 'scopes' tag.
Jia Li: confirming — the rewrap job dropped the custom 'route_allowlist' tag when key version metadata rekeyed. auth-svc then fell back to service-account defaults (which include chat).
Ben Ortega: can we short-circuit? block chat endpoints for any token with provenance=="kms-rotated-temporary" until we fix serializer. quick mitigation: apply WAF rule to reject tokens with header x-token-provenance: rotated until patch.
Mira Chen: good call. I'm going to patch the WAF rule and throttle chat completions from internal IPs. doing it now.
deploy-bot: deploy starting: auth-svc@hotfix/scope-deser-guard (rev 4f2b9) — will add safe-check for missing route_allowlist tag.
Samir Patel: paste the buggy check we found: ```js
// buggy: falls back to broad defaults
const scopes = token.scopes || token.metadata['scopes'] || [];
if (scopes.includes('embeddings') && route.startsWith('/chat')) {
  return allow(); // oops
}
```
Aleks Novak: proposed fix: require explicit allowlist origin and fail-closed on missing kms tag: ```js
const allowlist = parseAllowlist(token);
if (!allowlist || !validateOrigin(token)) return deny();
if (allowlist.includes(routeCategory(route))) return allow();
return deny();
```
Jia Li: ops note — we should also stop the nightly rewrap until we confirm metadata-preserving logic. pausing rewrap in jobs queue now.
ops-bot: rewrap-job queue paused by user=jia; job_id=rw_20241108_01 status=paused
Mira Chen: audit question — do we have a way to enumerate all tokens that were issued before the rewrap and could be affected? need to backfill logs and mark impacted tokens.
Ben Ortega: run query over token-issue table where issued_at < 2024-11-08T23:00:00Z and provenance='kms' and last_access > issued_at. we can then rate-limit or revoke those tokens. I'll run and share counts.
Ben Ortega: quick count returned ~132 tokens that match the predicate. majority are internal service accounts.
sec-oncall: filing INCIDENT-2024-11-08-AUTHZ. severity=P2. actionables: 1) revoke affected tokens or force refresh 2) rollback rewrap job or fix serializer then rewrap with metadata preserved 3) backfill audit logs + notify customers if any external keys impacted 4) add unit/integration tests for metadata roundtrip 5) add monitoring that alerts on route mismatches (embeddings token calling chat).
Mira Chen: deployed WAF rule active. temporary block for chat from tokens with provenance=rotated. initial impact looks limited.
deploy-bot: auth-svc hotfix succeeded — 1 instance restarted, health=OK, endpoint /internal/health OK.
Aleks Novak: followup PR to auth-svc will add explicit KMS tag schema versioning and defensive parsing. I'll open the PR and request review.
Samir Patel: also add an e2e test that performs a rewrap in a sandbox and asserts token.metadata roundtrips exactly.
Mira Chen: thanks all. Ben — please keep the token revocation plan and share the revocation log. Jia — keep rewrap paused until PR merged. I'll draft the incident blurb after we get counts. :white_check_mark:
